Financial highlights of 2025 include: •Total net sales increased 6% in 2025 from 2024, driven by our pillars of
growth and by high recurring revenues, which accounted for approximately 90% of total net sales. Favorable currency movements against the U.S. dollar
had a positive impact on total net sales by one percentage point over the
prior year. •The operating income margin in 2025 was 22.3% of sales compared with 4.9% in 2024. While the 2024 operating income margin included the
impact of the 2024 Efficiency Program discussed in Note 6 "Restructuring," the improvement in operating income margin also reflects a reduction in
operating expenses compared to 2024, driven by broad efficiency
improvements that facilitated reinvestments into growth initiatives. •Net cash provided by operating activities decreased 3% to $654 million in
